menu:7005990:1.text: Why are turkeys only born with two legs? Not enough to go around!
menu:7005990:1.source_cn: 每只火鸡为什么只有两条腿，完全不够吃！

say:1:1430102101:1.text: No way! There should still be... Wait! How come there's only one turkey leg left?!
say:1:1430102101:1.source_cn: 我没有！盘子里明明还有……怎么就剩一根鸡腿了？

say:2:1430102102:1.text: I only took a few bites... Oh, the chief is going to switch my backside for this!
say:2:1430102102:1.source_cn: 我明明只吃了几口而已……完了，这次村长一定会狠狠踢我的屁股！

say:3:1430102103:1.text: If I'm going to get yelled at anyway, then this last turkey leg is mine!
say:3:1430102103:1.source_cn: 等等，既然肯定会挨训，那我为什么还要留着这根鸡腿呢？

choice:menu:7005990:0.text: Did you eat all the turkey legs?
choice:menu:7005990:0.male: Did you eat all the turkey legs?
choice:menu:7005990:0.female: Did you eat all the turkey legs?

say:1:1430102201:1.text: No way! The chief will definitely get someone to make you a new plate of turkey!
say:1:1430102201:1.source_cn: 不会的！村长肯定会让人再准备一盘新火鸡腿的！

say:2:1430102202:1.text: I mean big shots like that must've eaten better food than anything of this. Who would care about a plate of turkey legs, right?
say:2:1430102202:1.source_cn: 而且那些大人物一定吃过更多好吃的，不会在意区区一盘火鸡腿的！

say:3:1430102203:1.text: But turkey legs are already so delicious... What in the world could taste better than this...?
say:3:1430102203:1.source_cn: 不过火鸡腿已经这么好吃了，比它还美味的食物得是什么味道啊……

choice:menu:7005990:1.text: We envoys have nothing to eat.
choice:menu:7005990:1.male: We envoys have nothing to eat.
choice:menu:7005990:1.female: We envoys have nothing to eat.

menu:7005990:2.text: Juicy, tender, smoky—I could eat them forever!
menu:7005990:2.source_cn: 香香嫩嫩火鸡腿！怎么吃都不够吃！

document:7:219:0.text:
Grind the <style="highlight">dry flamefern</style> with a grinder. Make sure the powder is fine enough.
Roast the <style="highlight">garlic leaves</style> until they are slightly charred. Then, grind them into a powder and mix it with the flamefern powder.
Add the powder mixture into the <style="highlight">honey amber dew</style>. Then, heat it gently until the powder dissolves completely.
document:7:219:0.source_cn:
取<style="highlight">干燥的火鳞草</style>，使用研磨器研磨成细粉，确保粉末足够细腻。
取<style="highlight">紫蒜叶</style>，用火烤至微微焦香，随后研磨成粉末，与火鳞草粉末充分混合。
取<style="highlight">蜂琥珀的蜜汁</style>加入上述粉末低温加热直至粉末溶解至不可见。
